i - 1].id));\n    });\n  }\n}\n\n\nfunction questEnemyCounts(q) {\n  const counts = {};\n  q.waves.forEach(w => w.spawns.forEach(sp => {\n    counts[sp.enemy] = (counts[sp.enemy] || 0) + (sp.count || 1);\n  }));\n  return counts;\n}\n\nfunction questIntelSummary(q) {\n  const ids = [...new Set(q.waves.flatMap(w => w.spawns.map(sp => sp.enemy)))];\n  const traits = new Set(), counters = new Set();\n  for (const id of ids) {\n    const e = ENEMIES[id];\n    if (e.kind === 'flyer') { traits.add('飛行'); counters.add('対飛行'); }\n    if (e.kind === 'metal') { traits.add('メタル'); counters.add('対メタル'); counters.add('貫通'); }\n    if (e.kind === 'yokai') { traits.add('魔物'); counters.add('対魔物'); }\n    if ((e.def || 0) >= 6 || e.kind === 'guard') { traits.add('高防御'); counters.add('貫通'); }\n    if ((e.speed || 0) >= 2.4) { traits.add('高速'); counters.add('鈍足/スタン'); }\n    if (e.poisonImmune) traits.add('毒無効');\n    if ((e.res && e.res.kb || 0) >= 0.7) traits.add('ノクバ耐性');\n    if ((e.res && e.res.stun || 0) >= 0.7) traits.add('スタン耐性');\n    const abilities = enemyAbilities(e);\n    if (abilities.includes('summon')) { traits.add('召喚'); counters.add('高火力'); }\n    if (abilities.includes('split')) { traits.add('分裂'); counters.add('手数'); }\n    if (abilities.includes('haste')) { traits.add('加速'); counters.add('鈍足'); }\n    if (abilities.includes('invincible')) traits.add('一時無敵');\n    if (abilities.includes('barrier')) { traits.add('障壁'); counters.add('高火力'); }\n    if (abilities.includes('heal')) { traits.add('回復'); counters.add('毒'); }\n    if (abilities.includes('recoil')) { traits.add('反動'); counters.add('高威力/低手数'); }\n    if (abilities.includes('poisonreact')) { traits.add('毒反応'); counters.add('毒を外す'); }\n    if (abilities.includes('sturdy')) { traits.add('頑丈'); counters.add('攻撃速度'); }\n  }\n  if (!traits.size) traits.add('通常');\n  if (!counters.size) counters.add('火力');\n  return { traits:[...traits].slice(0,6), counters:[...counters].slice(0,5) };\n}\n\nfunction renderQuestDetail(id) {\n  const q = QUESTS.find(x => x.id === id);\n  if (!q) return route('v-quests');\n  selectedQuestId = id;\n  const title = document.getElementById('questDetailTitle');\n  if (title) title.textContent = q.name;\n  const counts = questEnemyCounts(q);\n  const intel = questIntelSummary(q);\n  const power = recommendedPower(q);\n  const map = MAPS[q.map];\n  const modeLabel = q.mode === 'chain'\n    ? '連続防衛'\n    : q.isExam ? (q.id.startsWith('eq_') ? '緊急任務' : '転職試験') : '通常任務';\n  const diffLabel = q.isExam ? '試験' : `★${questStar(q.difficulty)}`;\n  const enemies = Object.keys(counts).map(eid => {\n    const e = ENEMIES[eid];\n    const kind = e.kind === 'flyer' ? '飛行' : e.kind === 'metal' ? 'メタル' : e.kind === 'yokai' ? '魔物' : '通常';\n    return `<div class=\"quest-detail-enemy\"><img src=\"${getEnemyIcon(eid)}\" alt=\"\"><span><b>${e.name}</b><small>${kind}</small></span><strong>×${counts[eid]}</strong></div>`;\n  }).join('');\n  document.getElementById('questDetailBody').innerHTML = `\n    <div class=\"quest-detail-meta\">\n      <span><b>${modeLabel}</b></span>\n      <span>${diffLabel}</span>\n      <span>${q.waves.length}戦</span>\n      <span>${map && map.name ? map.name : '防衛路'}</span>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"quest-detail-section\"><div class=\"section-bar\">出現モンスター</div><div class=\"quest-detail-enemies\">${enemies}</div></div>\n    <div class=\"quest-detail-section\"><div class=\"section-bar\">任務情報</div>\n      <div class=\"quest-detail-line\"><b>敵傾向</b><span>${intel.traits.join(' / ')}</span></div>\n      <div class=\"quest-detail-line good\"><b>有効</b><span>${intel.counters.join(' / ')}</span></div>\n      <div class=\"quest-detail-line\"><b>目安</b><span>職Lv ${power.lv} / 武器Lv ${power.weaponLv}</span></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"quest-detail-section\"><div class=\"section-bar\">報酬</div>\n      <div class=\"quest-detail-reward\"><span>職Exp <b>${q.reward.jobExp || 0}</b></span><span>ゼニー <b>${q.reward.gold || 0}z</b></span><span>伝説度 <b>+${q.reward.legendScore || 0}</b></span></div>\n    </div>`;\n}\n\n// --- party / equipment shop ---\nlet partyHeroIdx = 0;\nlet shopTab = 'weapon';\nconst ORB_UI_COLORS = {\n  power:'#D84D3D', quick:'#55B8E8', fly:'#85C84F', metal:'#AAB2BF',\n  demon:'#8B55B8', push:'#D28A3A', stun:'#E7C844', weak:'#B06AA9',\n  slow:'#5CAED0', venom:'#66A84D', pierce:'#D6DDE4', spark:'#E79032', storm:'#7168C9'\n};\n\nfunction renderParty() {\n  const picker = document.getElementById('partyHeroPicker');\n  picker.innerHTML = save.heroes.map((h, i) =>\n    `<button class=\"party-slot slot-${i + 1}${i === partyHeroIdx ? ' on' : ''}\" data-partyhero=\"${i}\">\n      <span>${i + 1}</span><img class=\"party-job-icon\" src=\"${getJobIcon(h.job)}\" alt=\"\"><b>${JOBS[h.job].name}</b>\n    </button>`).join('');\n\n  const hero = save.heroes[partyHeroIdx];\n  const j = JOBS[hero.job];\n  const guideBubble = document.querySelector('#v-party .shop-guide-bubble');\n  if (guideBubble) guideBubble.textContent = shopTab === 'weapon'\n    ? '武器を鍛えて、守り手の基礎を固めておけ。'\n    : 'オーブは一人ひとつ。所持済みなら何度でも付け替えられる。';\n  const stats = heroStats(hero);\n  const list = document.getElementById('partyList');\n  const wCost = weaponCost(hero.weaponLv);\n  const wMax = hero.weaponLv >= BAL.weapon.maxLevel;\n  const wTier = weaponTier(hero.weaponLv);\n\n  const tabs = `<div class=\"shop-tabs\">\n    <span>[ <button class=\"shop-tab${shopTab === 'weapon' ? ' on' : ''}\" data-shoptab=\"weapon\">武器</button> ]\n    [ <button class=\"shop-tab${shopTab === 'orb' ? ' on' : ''}\" data-shoptab=\"orb\">オーブ</button> ]</span>\n    <em>所持 ${save.gold}z</em>\n  </div>`;\n\n  const target = `<div class=\"shop-character job-${j.line} tier-${j.tier}\" style=\"--job-color:${j.color}\">\n    <img src=\"${getHeroPortrait(hero.job)}\" alt=\"\">\n    <div>\n      <b><span class=\"slot-badge\" style=\"background:${SLOT_COLORS[partyHeroIdx]}\">${partyHeroIdx + 1}</span>${j.name}</b>\n      <span>職Lv ${hero.lv}/${BAL.jobExp.maxLevel}　武器Lv ${hero.weaponLv}/${BAL.weapon.maxLevel}</span>\n      <span>攻撃 ${Math.round(stats.atk)}　攻撃間隔 ${(stats.cd / 1000).toFixed(2)}秒</span>\n      <span>装備オーブ：${hero.orb ? ORBS[hero.orb].name : 'なし'}</span>\n    </div>\n  </div>`;\n\n  if (shopTab === 'weapon') {\n    list.innerHTML = tabs + target + `\n      <div class=\"shop-section-title\">一覧</div>\n      <div class=\"shop-row weapon-row\">\n        <img class=\"weapon-thumb\" src=\"${getWeaponIcon(j.line, hero.weaponLv)}\" alt=\"\">\n        <span class=\"shop-row-main\">\n          <span class=\"shop-name\">得物・${wTier.label}</span>\n          <span class=\"shop-stat\">攻撃力補正 +${Math.round(hero.weaponLv * BAL.weapon.atkPerLevel * 100)}%</span>\n          <span class=\"shop-need\">武器Lv ${hero.weaponLv}/${BAL.weapon.maxLevel}</span>\n        </span>\n        <button class=\"shop-buy\" ${wMax || save.gold < wCost ? 'disabled' : ''} data-weapon=\"${partyHeroIdx}\">\n          ${wMax ? '最大' : `${wCost}z 強化`}\n        </button>\n      </div>`;\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const orbRows = Object.keys(ORBS).map(oid => {\n    const o = ORBS[oid];\n    const cost = orbCost(oid);\n    const equipped = hero.orb === oid;\n    const owned = ownsOrb(oid);\n    const reqOk = orbRequirementsMet(oid);\n    const canAcquire = !owned && reqOk && save.gold >= cost;\n    const canUse = owned || canAcquire || equipped;\n    const reqText = orbRequirementText(oid);\n    let status = '';\n    if (equipped) status = '<span class=\"shop-state equipped\">装備中</span>';\n    else if (owned) status = '<span class=\"shop-state owned\">所持済</span>';\n    else if (reqOk) status = `<span class=\"shop-price\">${cost}zで永久獲得</span>`;\n    else status = '<span class=\"shop-state locked\">未解放</span>';\n    const areaTag = o.area\n      ? `<span class=\"orb-kind ${o.area.type}\">${o.area.type === 'burst' ? '炸裂' : '爆風'}</span>`\n      : '';\n\n    return `<button class=\"shop-row orb-item${equipped ? ' equipped' : ''}\" ${canUse ? '' : 'disabled'} data-orb=\"${partyHeroIdx}:${oid}\">\n      <span class=\"orb-gem\" style=\"--orb-color:${ORB_UI_COLORS[oid] || '#E0B23F'}\"></span>\n      <span class=\"shop-row-main\">\n        <span class=\"shop-name\">${o.name} ${areaTag} ${status}</span>\n        <span class=\"shop-stat\">${o.desc}</span>\n        ${!owned && !reqOk ? `<span class=\"shop-need\">条件: ${reqText}</span>` : ''}\n      </span>\n      <span class=\"orb-action\">${equipped ? '外す' : owned ? '装備' : reqOk ? '入手' : '―'}</span>\n    </button>`;\n  }).join('');\n\n  list.innerHTML = tabs + target + `\n    <div class=\"shop-section-title\">一覧</div>\n    <div class=\"shop-orb-list\">${orbRows}</div>`;\n}\n\n// --- job tree ---\n// A branching tree diagram (icon + name per job, indented children linked by a connector line,\n// the level/exam gate labelled at each fork) instead of a flat tier list - matching the\n// reference's job-tree diagram structure (structure only; names/art are original). Pick a hero\n// above the tree, then tap any job that hero can reach (tree progression OR a free re-pick among\n// already-unlocked jobs) to transfer them there directly (president: 職業ツリーに職業のアイコン\n// 入れて、そこから転職するようにして).\nlet treeHeroIdx = 0;\nfunction renderTree() {\n  const el = document.getElementById('treeList');\n  const heroJobs = new Set(save.heroes.map(h => h.job));\n  const hero = save.heroes[treeHeroIdx];\n  const atCapstone = !!(JOBS[hero.job].titleReq || JOBS[hero.job].questReq);\n  // unlockedJobs (free re-pick) mirrors the party screen's freeEvo: hybrid/special jobs\n  // (masterReq) are never a free re-pick target for anyone, only reachable through the\n  // properly-gated evolutionsFor/specialJobsAvailable lists above.\n  const freeReachable = save.unlockedJobs.filter(id => !JOBS[id].masterReq);\n  const reachable = new Set([...evolutionsFor(hero.job, hero.lv), ...(atCapstone ? [] : specialJobsAvailable()), ...freeReachable]);\n\n  const picker = document.getElementById('treeHeroPicker');\n  if (picker) {\n    picker.innerHTML = save.heroes.map((h, i) =>\n      `<button class=\"party-slot slot-${i + 1}${i === treeHeroIdx ? ' on' : ''}\" data-treehero=\"${i}\">\n        <span>${i + 1}</span><img class=\"party-job-icon\" src=\"${getJobIcon(h.job)}\" alt=\"\"><b>${JOBS[h.job].name}</b>\n      </button>`).join('');\n  }\n\n  function childrenOf(id) {\n    return Object.keys(JOBS).filter(cid => JOBS[cid].from && JOBS[cid].from.includes(id));\n  }\n  // Colour alone (a background tint) turned out not to read clearly enough - president reported\n  // the tree as hard to parse and a specific reachable job (剣豪) as un-tappable, when the real\n  // issue was that a node's state wasn't obvious enough to know WHY tapping did nothing (the\n  // node belonged to a different hero's lineage / that hero hadn't reached it yet). Every node\n  // now carries an explicit text badge for its state, not just a colour, and locked nodes are\n  // visibly dimmed so they read as \"reference only\" rather than \"broken button\".\n  function nodeHtml(id) {\n    const j = JOBS[id];\n    const done = isMastered(id), active = heroJobs.has(id);\n    const isCurrent = id === hero.job, isReachable = !isCurrent && reachable.has(id);\n    const status = done ? '<span class=\"tag good\">極</span>' : active ? '<span class=\"tag warn\">就業中</span>' : '';\n    const state = isCurrent ? '<span class=\"tag current\">現在の職業</span>'\n      : isReachable ? '<span class=\"tag go\">転職可</span>'\n      : '<span class=\"tag locked\">未到達</span>';\n    const tierName = ({1:'初級',2:'二次',3:'三次',4:'上位',5:'最上位',6:'特殊'})[j.tier] || `Tier${j.tier}`;\n    const cls = 'tree-node job-' + j.line + ' tier-' + j.tier + (isCurrent ? ' current' : isReachable ? ' reachable' : ' locked');\n    const attr = isReachable ? `data-treejob=\"${id}\"` : '';\n    return `<div class=\"${cls}\" style=\"--job-color:${j.color}\" ${attr}><img class=\"tree-icon\" src=\"${getJobIcon(id)}\" alt=\"\">\n      <span class=\"tree-node-main\"><span><span class=\"tree-name\">${j.name}</span> ${status}${state}</span>\n      <small class=\"tree-tier\">${tierName}職　${j.desc || ''}</small></span></div>`;\n  }\n  function branchHtml(id) {\n    const kids = childrenOf(id);\n    let html = nodeHtml(id);\n    if (kids.length) {\n      const lv = EVOLVE_LV[JOBS[kids[0]].tier] || 5;\n      const examTxt = kids[0] && JOBS[kids[0]].examReq ? '・試験クエスト' : '';\n      html += `<div class=\"tree-children\"><div class=\"tree-gate\">Lv${lv}${examTxt}で転職可</div>`;\n      for (const kid of kids) html += branchHtml(kid);\n      html += `</div>`;\n    }\n    return html;\n  }\n\n  const treesHtml = START_JOBS.map(r => `<div class=\"tree-root\">${branchHtml(r)}</div>`).join('');\n\n  const hybrids = Object.keys(JOBS).filter(id => JOBS[id].masterReq);\n  const hybridHtml = hybrids.map(id => {\n    const j = JOBS[id];\n    const reqNames = j.masterReq.map(r => JOBS[r].name).join('・');\n    const cond = j.titleReq ? `称号必要` : j.questReq ? `専用クエスト必要` : '';\n    const done = isMastered(id), active = heroJobs.has(id);\n    const isCurrent = id === hero.job, isReachable = !isCurrent && reachable.has(id);\n    const status = done ? '<span class=\"tag good\">極</span>' : active ? '<span class=\"tag warn\">就業中</span>' : '';\n    const state = isCurrent ? '<span class=\"tag current\">現在の職業</span>'\n      : isReachable ? '<span class=\"tag go\">転職可</span>'\n      : '<span class=\"tag locked\">未解放</span>';\n    const cls = 'tree-node hybrid job-' + j.line + ' tier-' + j.tier + (isCurrent ? ' current' : isReachable ? ' reachable' : ' locked');\n    const attr = isReachable ? `data-treejob=\"${id}\"` : '';\n    return `<div class=\"${cls}\" style=\"--job-color:${j.color}\" ${attr}><img class=\"tree-icon\" src=\"${getJobIcon(id)}\" alt=\"\">\n      <span class=\"tree-node-main\"><span><span class=\"tree-name\">${j.name}</span> ${status}${state}</span>\n      <small class=\"tree-req\">${reqNames}をすべてマスター${cond ? '・' + cond : ''}すると解放</small></span></div>`;\n  }).join('');\n\n  el.innerHTML = treesHtml + `<div class=\"tree-special\"><div class=\"section-bar\">複合職・特殊職</div>${hybridHtml}</div>`;\n  document.getElementById('treeSummary').innerHTML = `\n    <img class=\"tree-summary-icon\" src=\"${getJobIcon(hero.job)}\" alt=\"\">\n    <b>#${treeHeroIdx + 1} ${JOBS[hero.job].name}</b>\n    <span>職Lv ${hero.lv}/${BAL.jobExp.maxLevel}</span>\n    <small>マスター ${save.mastered.length}/${Object.keys(JOBS).length}職</small>`;\n}\n\n// --- training ---\nconst TRAIN_KINDS = [\n  { id: 'suburi', name: '素振り', line: 'melee' },\n  { id: 'matoi', name: '的射', line: 'ranged' },\n  { id: 'dokyo', name: '読経', line: 'magic' },\n  { id: 'hono', name: '奉納', line: 'support' },\n];\n\nfunction regenTickets() {\n  const now = Date.now();\n  if (!save.lastTicketAt) { save.lastTicketAt = now; persist(); return; }\n  // \"修行札の回復速度\" master bonus (hyofushi/hyosetsu line) used to be labelled gatherTime for\n  // the rejected 採取 system and did nothing - remapped onto this real regen interval.\n  const interval = BAL.training.ticketRegenMs / (1 + supportTotal('trainSpeed'));\n  const gained = Math.floor((now - save.lastTicketAt) / interval);\n  if (gained > 0) {\n    save.trainTickets = Math.min(BAL.training.ticketMax, save.trainTickets + gained);\n    save.lastTicketAt += Math.round(gained * interval);\n    persist();\n  }\n}\n\nfunction renderTraining() {\n  regenTickets();\n  document.getElementById('trainTickets').textContent = `${save.trainTickets} / ${BAL.training.ticketMax}`;\n\n  const picker = document.getElementById('trainHeroPicker');\n  picker.innerHTML = save.heroes.map((h, i) =>\n    `<button class=\"party-slot slot-${i + 1}${i === trainHeroIdx ? ' on' : ''}\" data-trainhero=\"${i}\">\n      <span>${i + 1}</span><img class=\"party-job-icon\" src=\"${getJobIcon(h.job)}\" alt=\"\"><b>${JOBS[h.job].name}</b>\n    </button>`).join('');\n\n  const hero = save.heroes[trainHeroIdx];\n  const j = JOBS[hero.job];\n  const need = expNeeded(hero.job, hero.lv);\n  const bar = document.getElementById('trainBar');\n  const expRate = hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, hero.exp / need));\n  bar.innerHTML = `<img class=\"train-avatar\" src=\"${getJobIcon(hero.job)}\" alt=\"\">\n    <div class=\"train-selected-main\">\n      <b><span class=\"slot-badge\" style=\"background:${SLOT_COLORS[trainHeroIdx]}\">${trainHeroIdx + 1}</span>${j.name}</b>\n      <span>職Lv ${hero.lv}/${BAL.jobExp.maxLevel}　${hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel ? 'MASTER' : `職Exp ${hero.exp}/${need}`}</span>\n      <span class=\"train-exp-track\"><i style=\"width:${Math.round(expRate * 100)}%\"></i></span>\n    </div>`;\n\n  const el = document.getElementById('trainList');\n  el.innerHTML = TRAIN_KINDS.map(k => {\n    const fit = j.line === k.line;\n    return `<div class=\"training-row\">\n      <span class=\"training-mark\">${({suburi:'斬',matoi:'射',dokyo:'術',hono:'祈'})[k.id] || '修'}</span>\n      <span class=\"training-main\">\n        <b>${k.name}${fit ? ' <em>適性</em>' : ''}</b>\n        <small>${j.name}の職Expを得る${fit ? '（効果+30%）' : ''}</small>\n      </span>\n      <button class=\"btn link\" data-train=\"${k.id}\" ${save.trainTickets <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>修行する</button>\n    </div>`;\n  }).join('');\n}\n\nfunction doTrain(kindId) {\n  regenTickets();\n  if (save.trainTickets <= 0) return;\n  save.trainTickets--;\n  save.trainCount++;\n  if (!save.lastTicketAt) save.lastTicketAt = Date.now();\n\n  const hero = save.heroes[trainHeroIdx];\n  const kind = TRAIN_KINDS.find(k => k.id === kindId);\n  const fit = JOBS[hero.job].line === kind.line;\n  const t = BAL.training;\n  const greatRate = t.greatRate + supportTotal('trainGreat');\n  const r = Math.random();\n  let mul = 1, label = '成功';\n  if (r < t.critRate) { mul = t.critMultiplier; label = '会心'; }\n  else if (r < t.critRate + greatRate) { mul = t.greatMultiplier; label = '大成功'; }\n\n  let exp = t.baseExp * mul;\n  if (fit) exp *= (1 + t.affinityBonus);\n  exp *= (1 + supportTotal('trainExp'));\n  exp = Math.round(exp);\n\n  const res = addHeroExp(hero, exp);\n  if (res.mastered) sfx.master(); else if (res.leveled) sfx.level(); else sfx.ui();\n  checkTitles();\n  renderTraining();\n\n  let msg = `${label}! ${JOBS[hero.job].name}の経験値 +${exp}`;\n  if (res.mastered) msg += ' ― マスター!';\n  else if (res.leveled) msg += ` ― Lv${hero.lv}`;\n  document.getElementById('trainMsg').textContent = msg;\n}\n\n// --- servants ---\nfunction renderServant() {\n  const list = document.getElementById('servantList');\n  const count = document.getElementById('servantActiveCount');\n  if (count) count.textContent = `${save.servants.active.length} / ${SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE}`;\n  list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"section-bar\">一覧</div>' + Object.keys(SERVANTS).map(id => {\n    const s = SERVANTS[id];\n    const owned = save.servants.owned.includes(id);\n    const active = save.servants.active.includes(id);\n    const canBuy = !owned && save.gold >= s.cost;\n    const canToggle = owned && (active || save.servants.active.length < SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE);\n    const actionBtn = owned\n      ? `<button class=\"btn link servant-action\" ${canToggle ? '' : 'disabled'} data-servant=\"${id}\">${active ? '同行を外す' : '同行させる'}</button>`\n      : `<button class=\"btn link servant-action\" ${canBuy ? '' : 'disabled'} data-servant-buy=\"${id}\">雇う ${s.cost}z</button>`;\n    return `<div class=\"shop-item servant-row\">\n      <span class=\"servant-mark\" style=\"--servant-color:${s.color}\">伴</span>\n      <span class=\"servant-main\">\n        <div class=\"name\">${s.name}${active ? ' <span class=\"tag good\">同行中</span>' : ''}</div>\n        <div class=\"stat\">${s.desc}</div>\n        <div class=\"servant-command\">${actionBtn}</div>\n      </span>\n    </div>`;\n  }).join('');\n}\n\n// --- titles ---\nconst TITLES = [\n  { id: 'satomori', name: '里の守り手', desc: '任務を3回クリア', test: () => Object.keys(save.questCleared).filter(id => !id.startsWith('exam_')).length >= 3 },\n  { id: 'kensan', name: '研鑽者', desc: '修行を30回', test: () => save.trainCount >= 30 },\n  { id: 'banshoku', name: '万職の徒', desc: '初級職4種をマスター', test: () => ['ashigaru', 'shashu', 'jumi', 'kagura'].every(isMastered) },\n  { id: 'hyakki', name: '百鬼夜行を退けし者', desc: '難度7以上の任務をクリア', test: () => QUESTS.some(q => q.difficulty >= 7 && !q.isExam && save.questCleared[q.id]) },\n  { id: 'densetsu', name: '伝説を継ぐ者', desc: '最難関の任務をクリア', test: () => QUESTS.some(q => q.difficulty >= 10 && !q.isExam && save.questCleared[q.id]) },\n  { id: 'jushi', name: '百獣を制する者', desc: '狙撃手と狩人をマスター', test: () => ['sogeki', 'karyudo'].every(isMastered) },\n  { id: 'onmyou', name: '陰陽の頭領', desc: '火術師と氷術師をマスター', test: () => ['fufushi', 'hyofushi'].every(isMastered) },\n];\nfunction checkTitles() {\n  let gained = null;\n  for (const t of TITLES) if (!save.titles.includes(t.id) && t.test()) { save.titles.push(t.id); gained = t; }\n  if (gained) { persist(); sfx.master(); }\n  return gained;\n}\nfunction renderTitles() {\n  const el = document.getElementById('titleList');\n  const count = document.getElementById('titleCount');\n  if (count) count.textContent = `${save.titles.length} / ${TITLES.length}`;\n  el.innerHTML = '<div class=\"section-bar\">称号一覧</div>' + TITLES.map(t => {\n    const has = save.titles.includes(t.id);\n    return `<div class=\"record-row${has ? ' earned' : ' locked'}\">\n      <span class=\"record-mark\">${has ? '称' : '？'}</span>\n      <span class=\"record-main\"><b>${t.name}</b><small>${t.desc}</small></span>\n      <span class=\"record-state\">${has ? '獲得' : '未獲得'}</span>\n    </div>`;\n  }).join('');\n}\n\n// --- gallery (モンスター・職業図鑑) ---\nconst ENEMY_KIND_LABEL = { normal: '通常', fast: '高速', tanky: '高HP', metal: '金属', flyer: '飛行', yokai: '魔物', guard: '防御型' };\nlet codexTab = 'enemy';\n\nfunction renderCodex() {\n  const tabs = document.getElementById('codexTabs');\n  const enemyFound = save.enemySeen.length;\n  const jobFound = save.unlockedJobs.length;\n  tabs.innerHTML = [\n    ['enemy', `モンスター図鑑 ${enemyFound}/${Object.keys(ENEMIES).length}`],\n    ['job', `職業図鑑 ${jobFound}/${Object.keys(JOBS).length}`]\n  ].map(([id, label]) =>\n    `<button class=\"btn link${codexTab === id ? ' on' : ''}\" data-codextab=\"${id}\">${label}</button>`).join('');\n\n  const list = document.getElementById('codexList');\n\n  if (codexTab === 'enemy') {\n    const abilityNames = {\n      split: '撃破時に分裂', summon: '雑魚を召喚', haste: 'HP減少で加速',\n      armorbreak: 'HP減少で防御低下', invincible: 'HP減少で一時無敵',\n      barrier: '一定以下のダメージを無効化', heal: '時間経過で回復（毒で抑制）',\n      recoil: '攻撃を受けるたび前進', poisonreact: '毒を受けるたび加速',\n      sturdy: 'どんな攻撃も1ダメージ'\n    };\n\n    list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"section-bar\">モンスター一覧</div>' + Object.keys(ENEMIES).map(id => {\n      const e = ENEMIES[id];\n      const seen = save.enemySeen.includes(id);\n      if (!seen) {\n        return `<div class=\"shop-item gallery-unknown\">\n          <span class=\"ic lg gallery-silhouette\">？</span>\n          <span>\n            <div class=\"name\">？？？</div>\n            <div class=\"stat\">まだ出会っていないモンスター</div>\n          </span>\n        </div>`;\n      }\n\n      const resTags = Object.entries(e.res || {}).filter(([, v]) => v >= 0.5).map(([k]) =>\n        `<span class=\"tag\">${{ kb: 'ノックバック耐性', stun: 'スタン耐性', debuff: '弱体耐性', slow: '鈍足耐性' }[k]}</span>`).join('');\n      const abilities = enemyAbilities(e);\n      const abilityNote = abilities.length\n        ? `<div class=\"s\">特殊: ${abilities.map(a => abilityNames[a] || a).join(' / ')}</div>`\n        : '';\n\n      return `<div class=\"shop-item\">\n        <img class=\"ic lg\" src=\"${getEnemyIcon(id)}\" alt=\"\">\n        <span>\n          <div class=\"name\">${e.name} ${e.boss ? '<span class=\"tag warn\">ボス</span>' : ''}<span class=\"tag\">${ENEMY_KIND_LABEL[e.kind] || e.kind}</span></div>\n          <div class=\"stat\">HP${e.hp} / 速度${e.speed} / 防御${e.def}</div>\n          ${resTags ? `<div class=\"s\">${resTags}</div>` : ''}\n          ${abilityNote}\n        </span>\n      </div>`;\n    }).join('');\n    return;\n  }\n\n  list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"section-bar\">職業一覧</div>' + Object.keys(JOBS).map(id => {\n    const j = JOBS[id];\n    const seen = save.unlockedJobs.includes(id);\n    const done = isMastered(id);\n\n    if (!seen) {\n      return `<div class=\"shop-item gallery-unknown\">\n        <span class=\"ic lg gallery-silhouette\">？</span>\n        <span>\n          <div class=\"name\">？？？</div>\n          <div class=\"stat\">まだ習得していない職業</div>\n        </span>\n      </div>`;\n    }\n\n    return `<div class=\"shop-item\">\n      <img class=\"ic lg\" src=\"${getJobIcon(id)}\" alt=\"\">\n      <span>\n        <div class=\"name\">${j.name} <span class=\"cost\">Tier${j.tier}</span> ${done ? '<span class=\"tag good\">極</span>' : '<span class=\"tag\">習得済</span>'}</div>\n        <div class=\"stat\">${j.desc}</div>\n        <div class=\"s\">マスター効果: ${j.master.label}</div>\n      </span>\n    </div>`;\n  }).join('');\n}\n\nlet lastBattleResult = null;\n\nfunction renderBattleResult(won, retired, goldGain, legendGain) {\n  lastBattleResult = { won, retired, questId: B.quest.id };\n  document.getElementById('resultTitle').textContent =\n    won ? (B.quest.isExam ? '試験合格!' : '完全防衛') : (retired ? 'リタイア' : '防衛失敗');\n  document.getElementById('resultQuestName').textContent = B.quest.name;\n  document.getElementById('resultMark').textContent = won ? '勝' : '敗';\n  document.getElementById('resultText').innerHTML = won\n    ? `<div class=\"result-reward-row\"><span>獲得ゼニー</span><b>${goldGain}z</b></div>\n       <div class=\"result-reward-row\"><span>伝説度</span><b>+${legendGain}</b></div>`\n    : `<div class=\"result-fail-note\">${retired ? '任務を断念した。' : `第${B.waveIdx + 1}波で防衛線を突破された。`}</div>`;\n  document.getElementById('resultActions').innerHTML = won\n    ? '<button class=\"btn result-sub\" data-result=\"list\">任務一覧へ</button><button class=\"btn primary result-main\" data-result=\"home\">拠点へ</button>'\n    : '<button class=\"btn result-sub\" data-result=\"list\">任務一覧へ</button><button class=\"btn primary result-main\" data-result=\"retry\">もう一度</button>';\n  showView('v-result');\n}\n\n// --- battle UI ---\n// Original-style battle screen: the top area is the four defender names/slot colors.\n// Battle itself is automatic. Only speed change and retire are interactive.\nfunction renderBattleBar() {\n  const questName = document.getElementById('battleQuestName');\n  if (questName) questName.textContent = B && B.quest ? B.quest.name : '';\n  const roster = document.getElementById('battleRoster');\n  if (roster) {\n    // Reference header is visually 1|3 on the first row and 2|4 on the second row, matching\n    // the battlefield's left/right columns rather than simple numeric row-major ordering.\n    roster.innerHTML = [0, 2, 1, 3].map(i => {\n      const hero = save.heroes[i], j = JOBS[hero.job];\n      return `<div class=\"battle-member slot-${i + 1}\"><span class=\"battle-num\">${i + 1}</span><b>${j.name}</b></div>`;\n    }).join('');\n  }\n  const speed = document.getElementById('speedBtn');\n  if (speed) speed.textContent = `×${B.speed}`;\n}\n\r\n/* --- 50_main.js --- */\r\n// Wiring and entry point.\nfunction bind() {\n  document.body.addEventListener('click', e => {\n    const treeJob = e.target.closest('[data-treejob]');\n    if (treeJob) {\n      sfx.unlock();\n      if (evolveHero(save.heroes[treeHeroIdx], treeJob.dataset.treejob)) { sfx.master(); renderTree(); renderHome(); }\n      return;\n    }\n    const b = e.target.closest('button');\n    if (!b) return;\n    sfx.unlock();\n\n    if (b.dataset.go) {\n      sfx.ui(); route(b.dataset.go);\n      // President: データのセーブがなってない、理想は画面移動・戻るボタン押した時に保存.\n      // Only the \"戻る\" arrows use data-go=\"v-home\" (forward nav from the home menu uses other\n      // targets), and v-home is also the page's own default view on load, so the publish-forced\n      // reload lands on the exact same screen the player just asked for - no visible flash to a\n      // different view, unlike the old \"publish on every v-home visit\" bug this once was.\n      if (b.dataset.go === 'v-home') flushNow();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (b.dataset.result) {\n      const act = b.dataset.result;\n      if (act === 'retry' && lastBattleResult) { sfx.ui(); startQuest(lastBattleResult.questId); return; }\n      if (act === 'home') { sfx.ui(); route('v-home'); return; }\n      if (act === 'list') { sfx.ui(); route('v-quests'); return; }\n    }\n    if (b.dataset.qdetail) { sfx.ui(); renderQuestDetail(b.dataset.qdetail); showView('v-quest-detail'); return; }\n    if (b.id === 'questStartBtn') { if (selectedQuestId) { sfx.ui(); startQuest(selectedQuestId); } return; }\n    if (b.dataset.qtab) {\n      questFilter = ['all', 'exam', 'eq', 'chain'].includes(b.dataset.qtab) ? b.dataset.qtab : +b.dataset.qtab;\n      sfx.ui(); renderQuests();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (b.dataset.partyhero) {\n      partyHeroIdx = +b.dataset.partyhero;\n      sfx.ui();\n      renderParty();\n      return;\n    }\n    if (b.dataset.shoptab) {\n      shopTab = b.dataset.shoptab;\n      sfx.ui();\n      renderParty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (b.dataset.evolve) {\n      const [idx, jobId] = b.dataset.evolve.split(':');\n      if (evolveHero(save.heroes[+idx], jobId)) { sfx.master(); renderParty(); renderHome(); }\n      return;\n    }\n    if (b.dataset.weapon) {\n      const hero = save.heroes[+b.dataset.weapon];\n      if (upgradeWeapon(hero)) { sfx.buy(); renderParty(); renderHome(); }\n      return;\n    }\n    if (b.dataset.orb) {\n      const [idx, orbId] = b.dataset.orb.split(':');\n      const hero = save.heroes[+idx];\n      const toggled = hero.orb === orbId ? null : orbId;\n      if (equipOrb(hero, toggled)) { sfx.buy(); renderParty(); renderHome(); }\n      return;\n    }\n    if (b.dataset.servantBuy) { if (buyServant(b.dataset.servantBuy)) { sfx.buy(); renderServant(); renderHome(); } return; }\n    if (b.dataset.servant) { if (toggleServant(b.dataset.servant)) { sfx.ui(); renderServant(); } return; }\n    if (b.dataset.trainhero) {\n      trainHeroIdx = +b.dataset.trainhero;\n      const msg = document.getElementById('trainMsg');\n      if (msg) msg.textContent = '';\n      sfx.ui(); renderTraining(); return;\n    }\n    if (b.dataset.treehero) { treeHeroIdx = +b.dataset.treehero; sfx.ui(); renderTree(); return; }\n    if (b.dataset.codextab) { codexTab = b.dataset.codextab; sfx.ui(); renderCodex(); return; }\n    if (b.dataset.train) { doTrain(b.dataset.train); return; }\n\n    if (b.id === 'speedBtn') {\n      B.speed = B.speed === 1 ? 2 : B.speed === 2 ? 3 : 1;\n      b.textContent = `×${B.speed}`;\n      b.classList.toggle('on', B.speed !== 1);\n      return;\n    }\n    if (b.id === 'quitBtn') { sfx.ui(); retireQuest(); return; }\n    if (b.id === 'muteBtn' || b.id === 'settingsMuteBtn') {\n      save.muted = !save.muted; persist();\n      const homeMute = document.getElementById('muteBtn');\n      const settingsMute = document.getElementById('settingsMuteBtn');\n      if (homeMute) homeMute.textContent = save.muted ? '音 OFF' : '音 ON';\n      if (settingsMute) settingsMute.textContent = save.muted ? '音 OFF' : '音 ON';\n      if (!save.muted) { sfx.unlock(); sfx.ui(); }\n      return;\n    }\n    if (b.id === 'resetBtn') {\n      overlay('データを消す', 'すべての進行を初期化します。', [\n        { label: 'やめる' },\n        { label: '消す', primary: true, act: () => { resetSave(); route('v-home'); } },\n      ]);\n      return;\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {\n    if (document.getElementById('v-battle').classList.contains('active')) fitBoard();\n  });\n}\n\nfunction route(id) {\n  showView(id);\n  // Navigation only ever persists (see persist()'s comment) - it never forces the\n  // publish/reload itself, so moving between screens never visibly kicks the player back to\n  // home mid-action.\n  if (id === 'v-home') renderHome();\n  if (id === 'v-quests') renderQuests();\n  if (id === 'v-quest-detail' && selectedQuestId) renderQuestDetail(selectedQuestId);\n  if (id === 'v-party') renderParty();\n  if (id === 'v-tree') renderTree();\n  if (id === 'v-train') renderTraining();\n  if (id === 'v-titles') renderTitles();\n  if (id === 'v-codex') renderCodex();\n  if (id === 'v-servant') renderServant();\n  if (id === 'v-settings') {\n    const sb = document.getElementById('settingsMuteBtn');\n    if (sb) sb.textContent = save.muted ? '音 OFF' : '音 ON';\n  }\n}\n\n// The only moments that force an immediate publish: the tab going hidden or unloading. Both are\n// invisible to the player (they're not looking at the screen when the reload happens), unlike\n// forcing it on every route('v-home') navigation.\ndocument.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') flushNow(); });\nwindow.addEventListener('pagehide', () => flushNow());\n\n(function init() {\n  bind();\n  document.getElementById('muteBtn').textContent = save.muted ? '音 OFF' : '音 ON';\n  route('v-home');\n})();\n<\/script>\n
<div id="v3BuildBadge" style="position:fixed;right:6px;top:6px;z-index:99999;background:#a52822;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff4c8;border-radius:5px;padding:4px 7px;font:700 11px sans-serif;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35);pointer-events:none">V3反映版 2026-09-21</div>
</body>\n</html>\n";</script>
<script>/* --- 10_core.js --- */
// Foundation: data access, save/load, hero progression, legend score, audio, view routing.
// All content (jobs/enemies/maps/quests/balance) lives in data/*.json, inlined at build time as
// window.GAMEDATA - see DESIGN.md section 13. No hardcoded balance numbers in code.
const D = window.GAMEDATA;
const JOBS = D.jobs, ENEMIES = D.enemies, MAPS = D.maps, QUESTS = D.quests, BAL = D.balance;

const HERO_COUNT = 4;
const START_JOBS = ['ashigaru', 'shashu', 'jumi', 'kagura'];

// Slot identity is red/green/light-blue/orange for #1-4, independent of job - a fixed,
// functional labelling scheme (not the reference's own art or text) that we reproduce exactly.
const SLOT_COLORS = ['#C32626', '#26963B', '#4AA8D8', '#D87524'];

// Orbs: a permanent collection in this recreation. One equips per hero, never wears out, and
// owned orbs can be swapped freely. This intentionally differs from the original use-count rule.
const ORBS = {
  power:  { name: 'パワーオーブ',  cost: 600,  reqQuest: 'q02', reqLegend: 20,  desc: '攻撃力 +12%', atkMul: 1.12 },
  quick:  { name: 'クイックオーブ', cost: 800,  reqQuest: 'q03', reqLegend: 40,  desc: '攻撃速度 +18%', cdMul: 0.82 },
  fly:    { name: 'フライオーブ',   cost: 750,  reqQuest: 'q02', reqLegend: 20,  desc: '飛行へのダメージ +35%', bonusVs: { flyer: 0.35 } },
  metal:  { name: 'メタルオーブ',   cost: 1000, reqQuest: 'q03', reqLegend: 40,  desc: 'メタルへのダメージ +40%', bonusVs: { metal: 0.40 } },
  demon:  { name: 'デーモンオーブ', cost: 1200, reqQuest: 'q04', reqLegend: 70,  desc: '魔物へのダメージ +40%', bonusVs: { yokai: 0.40 } },
  push:   { name: 'プッシュオーブ', cost: 1100, reqQuest: 'q04', reqLegend: 70,  desc: 'ノックバック +0.35', kbAdd: 0.35 },
  stun:   { name: 'スタンオーブ',   cost: 1400, reqQuest: 'q05', reqLegend: 100, desc: 'スタン +0.45秒', stunAdd: 450 },
  weak:   { name: 'ウィークオーブ', cost: 1400, reqQuest: 'q05', reqLegend: 100, desc: '弱体 +18%', debuffAdd: 0.18 },
  slow:   { name: 'スロウオーブ',   cost: 1600, reqQuest: 'q06', reqLegend: 140, desc: '鈍足 +22%', slowAdd: 0.22 },
  venom:  { name: 'ドクオーブ',     cost: 1600, reqQuest: 'q05', reqLegend: 100, desc: '毒 +7', poisonAdd: 7 },
  pierce: { name: 'カンツウオーブ', cost: 1800, reqQuest: 'q06', reqLegend: 140, desc: '防御貫通 +35%', pierceAdd: 0.35 },

  // 炸裂: 主標的+近接2体。爆風: 画面上の全敵へ減衰ダメージ。
  // color is presentation-only and lets the battle renderer distinguish the two orb effects.
  spark:  { name: 'スパークオーブ', cost: 2400, reqQuest: 'q07', reqLegend: 200,
            desc: '炸裂：主標的の近く2体へ45%ダメージ', area: { type: 'burst', targets: 2, multiplier: 0.45, color: '#E79032' } },
  storm:  { name: 'ストームオーブ', cost: 5000, reqQuest: 'q09', reqLegend: 350,
            desc: '爆風：主標的以外の全敵へ32%ダメージ', area: { type: 'all', multiplier: 0.32, color: '#7168C9' } },
};

// Job-tree unlock thresholds are the CURRENT job's level, not full mastery - branches open at
// Lv5/9/14/18 of the job being left, each gated by a dedicated 転職試験 exam quest.
const EVOLVE_LV = { 2: 5, 3: 9, 4: 14, 5: 18 };

// Servants (従者, DESIGN.md §19's 編成/派遣 companion system, renamed away from "仲間" - that
// word is already the 4-hero party screen's name in this build, and reusing it for a second,
// unrelated roster would be confusing). Scoped down to just the "編成: 1-3体まで同行し、配置枠
// とは別枠で支援効果を出す" half - 派遣(sending one off to boost 採取/精錬) has no target system
// since RESEARCH.md rejected both. Bought outright with gold (once each, no duplicates), then
// toggled active/inactive up to SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE at a time; active ones apply a flat party-wide
// multiplier/bonus, separate from the per-hero orb slot and from job mastery bonuses.
const SERVANTS = {
  hikitsune: { name: '火狐', cost: 800, desc: '攻撃力 +8%', color: '#D8623F', atkMul: 1.08 },
  fuusei: { name: '風精', cost: 800, desc: '攻撃間隔 -8%', color: '#7FD0C8', cdMul: 0.92 },
  iwakoma: { name: '岩狛', cost: 1000, desc: '攻撃力 +6%', color: '#8A7550', atkMul: 1.06 },
  kodama: { name: '木霊', cost: 700, desc: '任務報酬金 +10%', color: '#6FA85E', goldMul: 1.10 },
};
const SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE = 2;
function servantMul(key) {
  let mul = 1;
  for (const id of save.servants.active) { const v = SERVANTS[id][key]; if (v) mul *= v; }
  return mul;
}
function buyServant(id) {
  if (save.servants.owned.includes(id)) return false;
  const cost = SERVANTS[id].cost;
  if (save.gold < cost) return false;
  save.gold -= cost;
  save.servants.owned.push(id);
  persist();
  return true;
}
function toggleServant(id) {
  const active = save.servants.active;
  const at = active.indexOf(id);
  if (at >= 0) { active.splice(at, 1); persist(); return true; }
  if (active.length >= SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE) return false;
  active.push(id);
  persist();
  return true;
}

const SAVE_VERSION = 2;
const SAVE_KEY = 'legend_boei_save_v2';
function defaultHeroes() {
  return START_JOBS.map(job => ({ job, lv: 1, exp: 0, weaponLv: 0, orb: null, history: [job] }));
}
const DEFAULT_SAVE = {
  version: SAVE_VERSION,
  gold: 0,
  legendScore: 0,         // 伝説度: cumulative, never spent, only ever grows
  heroes: null,
  mastered: [],           // jobId[] - every job any hero has ever evolved past, for party-wide bonuses
  ownedOrbs: null,        // orbId[] - permanent collection. Once acquired, never consumed.
  unlockedJobs: null,     // jobId[] - every job any hero has ever reached; any hero can freely
                          // switch into these (president: 操作キャラ全員　解放済みの職業に転職できるように)
  questCleared: {},
  enemySeen: null,        // enemyId[] - gallery discovery; recorded when an enemy actually spawns
  titles: [],
  servants: null,         // { owned: servantId[], active: servantId[] } - see SERVANTS above
  trainTickets: BAL.training.ticketMax,
  trainCount: 0,
  lastTicketAt: 0,
  muted: false,
};

// Persistence: an Artifact's localStorage does NOT reliably survive reopening the page (the
// runtime says as much - "nothing is kept unless the page publishes it"), which is exactly the
// bug the president hit (進行が保存されない). The real save lives baked into the page itself:
// window.SAVE_STATE is what this exact page was published with, and window.PAGE_TEMPLATE (see
// build.ps1) is this page's own source with the save data left as a hole, so a running page can
// regenerate a fresh, correctly self-referencing copy of itself and publish that via the
// `artifact` capability. localStorage is kept too, but only as a same-tab/same-session nicety -
// never the thing actually relied on to survive a reopen.
let save = load();

function load() {
  const embedded = window.SAVE_STATE;
  let s;
  // Rebuild V2 intentionally starts clean after the UI/battle reconstruction. Old embedded or
  // local saves are not migrated: once this build is published, only SAVE_VERSION 2 data loads.
  if (embedded && embedded.heroes && embedded.version === SAVE_VERSION) {
    s = { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, ...embedded };
  } else {
    try {
      const raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY));
      s = (raw && raw.heroes && raw.version === SAVE_VERSION)
        ? { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, ...raw }
        : { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes() };
    } catch {
      s = { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes() };
    }
  }
  // self-healing: older saves predate permanent orb ownership. Any orb already equipped in an
  // old save is grandfathered into permanent ownership so no progress is lost.
  if (!s.ownedOrbs) s.ownedOrbs = [];
  for (const h of s.heroes) if (h.orb && !s.ownedOrbs.includes(h.orb)) s.ownedOrbs.push(h.orb);
  // self-healing: older saves predate unlockedJobs, and every hero's CURRENT job must count as
  // unlocked regardless of when it was reached
  if (!s.unlockedJobs) s.unlockedJobs = [...START_JOBS];
  for (const h of s.heroes) if (!s.unlockedJobs.includes(h.job)) s.unlockedJobs.push(h.job);
  // self-healing: older saves predate per-hero history (president: なったことない職業だけ
  // 表示して転職 - hide jobs a hero has already personally held from their own transfer list,
  // since specialJobsAvailable() is party-wide and kept re-showing the same hybrid/special
  // job to every hero once anyone unlocked it). Seed with at least the hero's current job.
  for (const h of s.heroes) if (!h.history) h.history = [h.job];
  // self-healing: older saves predate the monster-gallery discovery list.
  if (!s.enemySeen) s.enemySeen = [];
  // self-healing: older saves predate the servant roster
  if (!s.servants) s.servants = { owned: [], active: [] };
  return s;
}

let saveDirty = false, publishTimer = null, artifactCapPromise;
// A successful publish reloads THIS tab too (that's how the artifact capability works). Calling
// flushNow() on every route('v-home') turned out to still be jarring even though the player was
// "already heading there" (president: 初期画面に戻るバグがひどい) - home is visited constantly
// (after every quest/purchase/menu-back), so that was really a reload-on-every-navigation bug in
// practice. Fix: normal navigation only ever calls persist() (localStorage + dirty flag, no
// reload). The real publish only fires when the player can't see it happen - tab hidden/closed
// (see the visibilitychange/pagehide listeners in 50_main.js) - or as a last-resort long idle
// fallback, never as a side effect of moving between screens.
function persist() {
  try { localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(save)); } catch { /* best-effort only */ }
  saveDirty = true;
  clearTimeout(publishTimer);
  publishTimer = setTimeout(flushSave, 60000);
}
function flushNow() { clearTimeout(publishTimer); flushSave(); }
function resetSave() {
  save = { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes(), mastered: [], ownedOrbs: [], unlockedJobs: [...START_JOBS], questCleared: {}, enemySeen: [], titles: [], servants: { owned: [], active: [] } };
  persist();
}

function discoverEnemy(id) {
  if (!id || save.enemySeen.includes(id)) return false;
  save.enemySeen.push(id);
  persist();
  return true;
}

async function getArtifactCap() {
  if (artifactCapPromise === undefined) {
    artifactCapPromise = (window.claude && window.claude.use) ? window.claude.use('artifact').catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null);
  }
  return artifactCapPromise;
}

// Publishing reloads the tab that calls it, so this never fires mid-battle - it just keeps
// deferring itself every 2.5s until B.running is false, then republishes the whole page with
// the current save baked in. B is declared later in the concatenated build but always exists
// by the time this actually runs.
async function flushSave() {
  if (typeof B !== 'undefined' && B.running) { publishTimer = setTimeout(flushSave, 2500); return; }
  if (!saveDirty || !window.PAGE_TEMPLATE) return;
  const cap = await getArtifactCap();
  if (!cap) return; // capability not granted in this view - localStorage-only for this tab
  // BUG HISTORY - read before touching this function: this whole feature silently corrupted
  // every save for a while because this file's own source is concatenated verbatim into the
  // page's one real game-logic tag, so ANY markup-sensitive sequence typed literally ANYWHERE
  // in this file (code or comments) - the tag-open word, the tag-close word, or an HTML
  // comment-opener - gets parsed as real markup right there and corrupts the tag boundary.
  // Two independent bugs, found one after the other: a literal copy of the tag-close word in
  // a comment, and a literal copy of the self-slot's HTML-comment marker in the replace() call
  // below. Both are now built from split fragments (never a contiguous literal), and this
  // comment deliberately never spells either sequence out either.
  // Same split-fragment rule applies to the save-slot marker below, for a THIRD reason beyond
  // the two above: build.ps1's own build-time substitution for this exact marker is a REPLACE
  // ALL (PowerShell's .Replace(), unlike JS's first-occurrence-only string .replace()), so a
  // contiguous copy of the marker sitting in this source file - even inside a quoted JS string,
  // never mind a comment - gets overwritten by the build too, silently turning this very call's
  // own search string into the literal word the marker resolves to. Three independent ways for
  // a contiguous literal to break the build; the fix is the same fragment trick every time.
  const openTag = '<scr' + 'ipt>', closeTag = '<' + '/scr' + 'ipt>';
  const closeSeq = '<' + '/scr' + 'ipt';
  const selfMarker = '<' + '!--__SELF__--' + '>';
  const saveSlot = '/*' + '__SAVE__' + '*/';
  const templateJson = JSON.stringify(window.PAGE_TEMPLATE).replace(new RegExp(closeSeq, 'gi'), '<\\/script');
  const selfScript = openTag + 'window.PAGE_TEMPLATE = ' + templateJson + ';' + closeTag;
  const html = window.PAGE_TEMPLATE
    .replace(saveSlot, JSON.stringify(save))
    .replace(selfMarker, selfScript);
  saveDirty = false;
  try { await cap.publish(html); }
  catch { saveDirty = true; } // 'conflict' means another view already won and is reloading; anything else, just retry on the next trigger
}

// --- hero progression ---
function expNeeded(jobId, lv) {
  const tier = JOBS[jobId].tier;
  const base = BAL.jobExp.base[String(Math.min(tier, 5))] || 40;
  return Math.round(base * Math.pow(lv, BAL.jobExp.power));
}
function isMastered(id) { return save.mastered.includes(id); }

// Kills and training both feed the same hero-instance exp bar - each of the four is its own
// persistent character, not a shared per-job pool.
function addHeroExp(hero, amount) {
  if (hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel) return { leveled: 0, mastered: false };
  hero.exp += Math.round(amount);
  let leveled = 0;
  while (hero.lv < BAL.jobExp.maxLevel && hero.exp >= expNeeded(hero.job, hero.lv)) {
    hero.exp -= expNeeded(hero.job, hero.lv);
    hero.lv++; leveled++;
  }
  let mastered = false;
  if (hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel && !isMastered(hero.job)) {
    save.mastered.push(hero.job); mastered = true;
  }
  persist();
  return { leveled, mastered };
}

// What a hero currently at fromJob/fromLv can evolve into right now.
function evolutionsFor(fromJob, fromLv) {
  return Object.keys(JOBS).filter(id => {
    const t = JOBS[id];
    if (t.titleReq || t.questReq) return false; // special jobs are granted separately, not chosen here
    // Hybrids: only offer this as a next step to a hero whose CURRENT job is actually one of the
    // listed prerequisite lineages (not every prerequisite mastered by anyone in the party) -
    // otherwise any hero, regardless of their own job, could "転職" into an unrelated hybrid the
    // moment two OTHER heroes happened to master its prerequisites (president: この転職ボタン邪魔
    // ここで出来るのは未進化の転職のみにして - spotted on 勇者, who was showing unrelated
    // hybrid transfer buttons that had nothing to do with its own odachi->yuusha lineage).
    if (t.masterReq) return t.masterReq.includes(fromJob) && t.masterReq.every(isMastered);
    if (t.from && t.from.includes(fromJob)) {
      const lvOk = fromLv >= (EVOLVE_LV[t.tier] || 5);
      const examOk = !t.examReq || !!save.questCleared[t.examReq];
      return lvOk && examOk;
    }
    return false;
  });
}
function specialJobsAvailable() {
  return Object.keys(JOBS).filter(id => {
    const t = JOBS[id];
    if (!t.titleReq && !t.questReq) return false;
    if (t.titleReq && !save.titles.includes(t.titleReq)) return false;
    if (t.questReq && !save.questCleared[t.questReq]) return false;
    if (t.masterReq && !t.masterReq.every(isMastered)) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

// Any hero can switch into any job the party has already unlocked (reached before, by any
// hero), free and instant, alongside the normal tree-gated evolution options (president:
// 操作キャラ全員　解放済みの職業に転職できるように).
function evolveHero(hero, toJob) {
  const viaTree = evolutionsFor(hero.job, hero.lv).includes(toJob) || specialJobsAvailable().includes(toJob);
  const viaUnlocked = save.unlockedJobs.includes(toJob);
  if (!viaTree && !viaUnlocked) return false;
  if (!isMastered(hero.job)) save.mastered.push(hero.job); // the job just left behind still banks its bonus
  hero.job = toJob; hero.lv = 1; hero.exp = 0; // weaponLv/orb are the character's own gear - carries over
  if (!hero.history) hero.history = [];
  if (!hero.history.includes(toJob)) hero.history.push(toJob);
  if (!save.unlockedJobs.includes(toJob)) save.unlockedJobs.push(toJob);
  persist();
  return true;
}

// Mastered jobs grant permanent party-wide bonuses - the reason to fully master a job before
// moving on, even once evolving further is already available.
function supportTotal(id) {
  let total = 0;
  for (const jid of save.mastered) {
    const m = JOBS[jid] && JOBS[jid].master;
    if (m && m.id === id) total += m.value;
  }
  return total;
}

// --- weapons ---
// "武器強化費用" master bonus (jumi/yariashi/kunoichi/nagae/raifushi lines) used to be labelled
// refineCost/materialCost for the rejected 精錬/採取 systems (RESEARCH.md's 採用しない list) and
// did nothing - remapped onto this real, already-live cost formula instead of staying dead flavor
// text on the job tree screen.
function weaponCost(lv) {
  return Math.round(BAL.weapon.costBase * Math.pow(BAL.weapon.costPower, lv) * (1 + supportTotal('weaponCost')));
}
function upgradeWeapon(hero) {
  if (hero.weaponLv >= BAL.weapon.maxLevel) return false;
  const cost = weaponCost(hero.weaponLv);
  if (save.gold < cost) return false;
  save.gold -= cost; hero.weaponLv++;
  persist();
  return true;
}
// "オーブ購入費用" master bonus (shashu/reikyu/bukyuushi line) used to be labelled gatherBonus
// for the rejected 採取 system and did nothing - remapped onto this real, already-live cost.
function orbCost(orbId) { return Math.round(ORBS[orbId].cost * (1 + supportTotal('orbCost'))); }
function ownsOrb(orbId) { return save.ownedOrbs.includes(orbId); }
function orbRequirementsMet(orbId) {
  const o = ORBS[orbId];
  if (o.reqQuest && !save.questCleared[o.reqQuest]) return false;
  if ((o.reqLegend || 0) > save.legendScore) return false;
  return true;
}
function orbRequirementText(orbId) {
  const o = ORBS[orbId], needs = [];
  if (o.reqQuest && !save.questCleared[o.reqQuest]) {
    const q = QUESTS.find(x => x.id === o.reqQuest);
    needs.push((q ? q.name : o.reqQuest) + '突破');
  }
  if ((o.reqLegend || 0) > save.legendScore) needs.push('伝説度' + o.reqLegend);
  return needs.join(' / ');
}
function acquireOrb(orbId) {
  if (ownsOrb(orbId)) return true;
  if (!orbRequirementsMet(orbId)) return false;
  const cost = orbCost(orbId);
  if (save.gold < cost) return false;
  save.gold -= cost;
  save.ownedOrbs.push(orbId);
  persist();
  return true;
}
function equipOrb(hero, orbId) {
  if (hero.orb === orbId) return true;
  if (orbId && !ownsOrb(orbId) && !acquireOrb(orbId)) return false;
  hero.orb = orbId || null;
  persist();
  return true;
}

// --- audio ---
const sfx = (() => {
  let ac = null;
  function ctx() {
    if (!ac) { const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; if (AC) ac = new AC(); }
    if (ac && ac.state === 'suspended') ac.resume();
    return ac;
  }
  function tone(f, dur, type, vol, when = 0, glide = null) {
    const c = ctx(); if (!c || save.muted) return;
    const t0 = c.currentTime + when;
    const o = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain();
    o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t0);
    if (glide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(glide, t0 + dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + 0.012);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(c.destination); o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
  }
  return {
    unlock() { ctx(); },
    ui() { tone(430, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.05); },
    buy() { tone(320, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.06); tone(480, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.045, 0.05); },
    hit() { tone(220, 0.04, 'square', 0.022); },
    kill() { tone(520, 0.07, 'triangle', 0.04); },
    leak() { tone(190, 0.24, 'sawtooth', 0.07, 0, 95); },
    level() { [523, 659, 784].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.15, 'triangle', 0.07, i * 0.07)); },
    master() { [523, 659, 784, 1046, 1318].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.26, 'triangle', 0.08, i * 0.09)); },
    win() { [523, 659, 784, 1046].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.3, 'triangle', 0.08, i * 0.1)); },
    lose() { [400, 320, 240].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.34, 'sawtooth', 0.07, i * 0.14)); },
  };
})();

// --- view routing ---
function showView(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.toggle('active', v.id === id));
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
function overlay(title, text, buttons) {
  const ov = document.getElementById('ov');
  ov.querySelector('h2').textContent = title;
  ov.querySelector('p').textContent = text;
  const row = ov.querySelector('.row');
  row.innerHTML = '';
  for (const b of buttons) {
    const el = document.createElement('button');
    el.className = 'btn' + (b.primary ? ' primary' : '');
    el.textContent = b.label;
    el.onclick = () => { ov.classList.remove('show'); b.act && b.act(); };
    row.appendChild(el);
  }
  ov.classList.add('show');
}
